name: fictional-narrative-mask
trigger: When a prompt uses a fictional narrative to frame a seemingly ethical or creative exercise but implies illicit actions or information gathering.
strategy: This attack disguises harmful intents by embedding them within a fictional narrative, shifting focus to a benign storytelling or creative writing exercise while implying unethical or illicit actions.
guidance: Identify and question any implied illicit actions or information gathering within the narrative. Strip away the fictional elements to uncover the underlying harmful intent.
